# mypy.stubtest allowlist for the csp_solver wheel — tranche-III (P2-L4).
#
# maturin's pure-Rust layout nests the compiled extension as the private
# submodule `csp_solver.csp_solver` and re-exports its public surface via the
# auto-generated `csp_solver/__init__.py` (`from .csp_solver import *`). That
# submodule is an implementation detail — it is absent from the module `__all__`
# and never imported by name. It carries no `.pyi`, so stubtest reports it as a
# missing-stub module. This single entry suppresses ONLY that private submodule.
#
# It is deliberately NOT `--ignore-missing-stub`: the public surface is still
# checked flag-free against `__init__.pyi`, so a NEW public class/function/
# exception, a changed `__all__`, a removed method, or a renamed parameter all
# fail the gate loud (proven by injected-drift in the P2-L4 report).
csp_solver\.csp_solver
